32. Define allotropy. Show that diamond and graphite consist of carbon only.
[2+31 Allotropy: The two or more forms of the same element having same chemical propernes but different physical properties are allopropes and the phenomenon is called Allotropy.

Experiment shows that both diamond and graphite contain carbon only: 1 g of diamond is taken in combustion tube and heated in the presence of excess of air. carbondioxide gas is evolved which is passed through the aqueous solution of KOH. The KOH solution is kept in different bulbs which are kept in series. The carbondioxide gas evolved absorbed by KOH solution. The weight of C02 gas is taken.
The same experiment is done in 1 g of graphite and again weight of C02 gas is taken.

Experimentally, it is found that the weight of carbondioxide gas produced by diamond is to the weight of carbondioxide produced by graphite. This result shows both diamond and graphite contains same weight of carbon only.

Allotropes of Carbon: The phenomenon of the existence of an elements in different forms which have different physical properties but similar chemical properties is known as allotropy.

Following are the allotropes of carbon: Crystalline forms: Diamond and Graphite Diamond: It is purest, crystalline and hardest form of carbon. It occurs in the form of transparent octahedral crystals which usually have curved surface and do not shine much in their natural forms. They are cut at proper angle so as to give rise to large total internal reflection which lends them the usual shine. The carbon atoms are arranged tetrahedrally in diamond by forming sp3-hybridization. Each sp3 hybrid orbital carbon atom is linked to its neighbours by four single covalent bonds. This leads to three dimensional network of covalent bonds which makes it very hard and has high melting point and boiling point.

Fig: Diamond Graphite: The carbon atoms are arranged rn regular hexagonal in flat parallel layers resulting the formation of the large plates. Each carbon atoms in these layers is bonded to three others by sp2hybridization. Each layer or large plate is bonded to adjacent layers by weak Vander Waal force. Due to this each layer can slide each other easily. So, one electron is left non-bonded in each carbon atom. Due to the presence of mobile electrons, graphite is good conductor of heat and electricity. atonus an one layer: a stack of layers:

Coke: It is balck solid mass which is obtained by the destructive distillation of coal. It is used as reducing agent in metallurgy.
Charcoal: It is black soft form of carbon. The main varieties of charcoal are as:
Lamp black: It is obtained by burning oil in the absence of air or limited supply of air.
Sugar charcoal: It is obtained by heating sugar in the absence of air. It is used as black Pigment Wood charcoal: It is obtained by destructive distillation of wood in the absence of air.
Animal charcoal: It is obtained by destructive distillation of animal bones.
